inputs.text: A complex multi-tiered bioluminescent terrarium and clockwork mycology ecosystem, standing on a carved stone plinth against a dark background. A hand-blown glass terrarium shaped like an inverted ancient amphora, wrapped in a recursive spiral brass framework. Inside, a lush miniature landscape of glowing deep indigo and violet bioluminescent fungi integrated with polished brass and oxidized copper clockwork mechanisms and tiny interlocking gears. At its core, a pulsing amethyst crystal cluster held by a delicate clockwork claw. On the plinth to either side, smaller matching glass vials glow with emerald green and deep crimson liquid on miniature brass stands. Lighting is dark and rich, driven by the bioluminescence and a deep-space glow behind the terrarium, casting complex reflections across the glass and brass. Dark academia atmosphere, intricate engraved detail, photorealistic fantasy prop photography.
Cartoon, sketch, low detail, overexposed, modern setting, plain glass, extra text, logos, UI elements, navigation arrows, buttons, on-screen overlays, watermark.
